line: PLATECROSS SELECTION: NEGATIVE: no qualified seed, no bench (qualified = v2 PASS AND QUALIFIED; s0 v2 PASS / NOT QUALIFIED (push 20/60), s1 v2 PASS / NOT QUALIFIED (push 12/60), s2 v2 FAIL / NOT QUALIFIED (push 17/60))
reason: NEGATIVE: no qualified seed, no bench
bench: NEGATIVE: no qualified seed, no bench

s0.qualify_detail: turn 10/10 (need 9), walk 3/3 (need 2), push 20/60 = 0.3333 (need <= 0.15); arms-platecross2-clocks2-s0 is a single checkpoint, not a reliable recipe

s1.qualify_detail: turn 10/10 (need 9), walk 1/3 (need 2), push 12/60 = 0.2 (need <= 0.15); arms-platecross2-clocks2-s1 is a single checkpoint, not a reliable recipe

s2.qualify_detail: turn 10/10 (need 9), walk 0/3 (need 2), push 17/60 = 0.2833 (need <= 0.15); arms-platecross2-clocks2-s2 is a single checkpoint, not a reliable recipe

rule: the three fine-tuned final checkpoints go through the unchanged turn qualification (turn_test v2 + cpu_turn_qualify); the qualified seed with the lowest push-fall rate (tie: lowest seed index) is the SINGLE stage gait run on bench v2 under bench v2's rule (N = 41; >= 39/41 clears, 0 falls, >= 11/10/9/7 per heading) with the generic stage-gait override; no qualified seed -> NEGATIVE (no bench).
labels: Labels: LEARNED gait (fine-tuned from clock-s2 on half plates, half flat ground (F1)); MuJoCo gates; bench v2's 180-deg timing caveat applies.
reading: A seed is qualified iff it both PASSES turn_test v2 (its <run>.json verdict, under the unchanged v2 protocol) AND is QUALIFIED by cpu_turn_qualify's unchanged rule (its <run>__qualify.json verdict), as the R1 / v5 joint rule counts a seed (turngait_r12_verdict.seed_counts); a seed that fails v2 does not count even if cpu_turn_qualify says QUALIFIED. The push-fall rate is falls / n of the qualify JSON's push clause (n = 60). Every seed needs its training record, v2 JSON (with the unchanged v2 protocol's rule block) and qualify JSON, all for the same exported deploy.yaml; otherwise the selection is INCOMPLETE and nothing is written.
disclosed: clock-s2's straight-walk drift (R1 walk drift 19.8 / 10.8 / 2.4 deg on qualify walk seeds 10-12) is inherited and is the baseline; R1's feet_swing_height reward (unchanged) measures foot height in absolute world z (gait_clock_mdp.feet_swing_height: flat plane, ground z = 0), so over a plate its swing-clearance target is 0.03 m lower relative to the plate top; feet in contact are excluded, and it is the only absolute-z term among R1's 19 reward and 2 termination terms; bench v2's 180-deg timing caveat applies
